if expected and type(value) not in [_SCHEMA_TYPES[t] for t in (

evidence.reason: The current implementation still indexes `_SCHEMA_TYPES[t]` for every schema type name without validating that the name is supported. An unsupported receipt-schema type such as `number` therefore raises `KeyError` instead of returning the promised schema diagnostic. This is an implementation error in `schema_problem`, not merely a request to enlarge requirements, and it can abort receipt evaluation and lose the health result.
